Name: Salcah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Manasseh's allotment east of the Jordan
Description: Salcah was a town in Manasseh's allotment east of the Jordan, named in the town list of Joshua 13. No further story is attached to it in Scripture, and its exact site is unidentified.
BiblicalSignificance: Its inclusion in the allotment list marks it as one of the towns assigned to Manasseh.
